# Hook & Roost Mortgage

> Hook & Roost Mortgage is the mortgage brokerage brand of Katie Luis (NMLS #2826935), a loan officer licensed in Washington and Massachusetts. Loans are offered through Edge Home Finance (NMLS #891464). As a broker, Katie shops each loan across many wholesale lenders rather than offering a single bank's products.

## About Katie Luis
- U.S. Army veteran and military spouse (husband is active duty Air Force); lives in Washington State.
- 20+ years in helping roles, first in healthcare, then the Army.
- Special focus on VA loans and military families, including PCS moves.
- Licensed in Washington and Massachusetts; with her team, can help borrowers in every U.S. state except New Jersey.

## Loan types
- First-time home buyer loans and down payment assistance guidance
- VA loans
- FHA loans
- USDA loans
- Conventional loans
- Jumbo loans
- Refinancing (rate/term and cash-out)
